fields.captureState: The project and thread list are seeded. The native app creates the project action, persists it after reload, and displays it in the toolbar and Script actions menu. This block does not run the command.
fields.defaultPixels: Default dialog fields and timing use frame-indexed crops from one whole readiness-corrected immutable native recording per theme; edited values or event timing use source DOM. Dialog-only native repeat raster variation is recorded explicitly.
fields.historicalMeasurements: Retained prior result values are historical; current source and new references require a fresh full exact-RGBA CLI proof. Original parity bytes are archived under history/project-action-native-v1.
